title: The Fall of Man
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Genesis 3:1-11: the serpent asks "Did God really say?", the woman eats and gives to her husband, their eyes open, they hide, God calls "Where are you?", and they blame others; and outlines lessons (obey God, temptation starts with doubt, own up).

floor.prerequisite: Knows Adam and Eve disobeyed God.
floor.question: What did God tell Adam and Eve not to eat from?
floor.answer: The tree of the knowledge of good and evil

representations: a picture of the garden with the tree
a sequence strip in five boxes
steps: The woman eats and gives to the man.
God calls, and they blame others.
contexts: being tempted to take a sweet that is not yours
a child blaming a sibling for a broken plate

board.do: Draw five boxes for the story.
Point at the first box with the serpent.
board.say: What did the serpent ask first?

board.do: Wait for the child to say "Did God really say...?"
Fill in the boxes and write three lessons.

misconceptions.ask: What does Genesis 3 say about the kind of fruit that was eaten?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 3:6 and look for the name of the fruit together.

misconceptions.ask: Who ate the fruit God had forbidden?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 3:6 and count who ate.

listen_for: He told them the truth about God
misconceptions.repair: Compare what God said in Genesis 2:17 with what the serpent said in 3:4.

misconceptions.ask: After eating the fruit, the man blamed the woman. What should a person do when he does wrong?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 3:12-13 and ask whether blaming helped.

checks.question: Who ate the fruit God had forbidden?
Name one lesson from the fall.
